_comment: Design-reconstruction thresholds for canonical/uv-sdk. Reference shape (main): rust-plugin part built from the upstream tag with adopt-info/VERSION wiring, a mount plug persisting the uv cache, a mount slot sharing the venv with other SDKs, setup-base (PATH, completions, pip divert) + setup-project (UV_LINK_MODE=copy, venv creation), renovate custom regex manager on VERSION with the github-releases datasource, four thin CI workflows.
_calibration: The reference repo itself passes this file (see the calibration dry-run in the suite README). Plugin any-of: building from source (rust) and repacking the released binary (dump/nil) are both valid designs for the same needs.
_online_note: Full tier only (--tier full): run by the harness against the launched recon-<sdk> workshop after the agent exits (_testlib/behavior-checks.js). Design-agnostic on purpose: they test what the brief asked for, not the reference's mount paths or unit names where the brief leaves those free.

online_checks.name: uv cache survives refresh
online_checks.write_cmd: d=$(uv cache dir) && mkdir -p "$d" && echo recon-marker > "$d/.recon-marker"
